name: Toukakijin
source:
You play Haruhime who's the daughter of a merchant. Haruhime wants to do nothing more than marry the richest man on the planet and live in the lap of luxury for the rest of her life. However this doesn't happen when her father decides that she's going to become the head of their household, and arranges for her to marry someone…!!?

[from [url=https://starryeyedcircus.wordpress.com/2011/09/11/%E3%80%8E-toukakijin-%E3%80%8F-trial/]Starry-eyed Circus[/url]]
